name: Distortion Strike — "gets +1/+0 until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn": one target, boost and trait
notes: Conor's decision 2026-10-13: rules about attacking, blocking and being targeted are traits (never ability lines), in the words of the card with the players filled in; Goaded is a trait only and names the player who goaded. Parser block 'Rules about attacking, blocking and being targeted' in cards-parser.js, _resolveTraitText in engine-helpers.js. The rule shares the target of the boost in its sentence (one picker, not two), and loses its duration words.
